elementTypes.name: Raft Foundations
standards: MBIE Guidelines on Raft Foundations Design

inspections.item: Subgrade inspection by the project Geotechnical Engineer
inspections.timeframe: Prior to placing hardfill, sand or concrete blinding layer

inspections.item: Reinforcement pre pour inspection by project Structural Engineer
observations: The ground beam dimensions and the slab thickness are in accordance with the approved drawings.
The ground beam longitudinal and transverse reinforcement are in accordance with the approved drawings.
Polythene underlay is installed beneath the reinforcement.
Cover to the reinforcement is provided in accordance with the drawings.
The floor slab reinforcing mesh is in accordance with the approved drawings.
Hold-down anchor bolts are installed in the locations shown on the drawings.
Formwork for the foundation slab is in good condition.

inspections.item: Any floor thickening requirements for posts or portal frames

elementTypes.scrNarrative: The raft slab was designed as per the MBIE guidance on raft slab design and the applicable NZ standards.
